αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλῃ: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. subj. 3 sg., tmesis ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’, in a purpose clause
βαρέα: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily’ (βαρέα στενάχοντα ’groaning heavily’)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα); clasping the knees is the suppliant’s gesture
γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
δέδμητο: δέμω — build; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been built’ · also homograph of δάμνημι/δαμάζω — subdue; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ‘had been subdued, was in subjection’ (λαὸς δέδμητο ὑπ’ αὐτῷ)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δείδω: δείδω (= δέδοικα) — fear, be afraid; pres. 1 sg., + μή and a verb: ’I fear that…’
δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διατμήξας: διατμήγω — cut apart, split; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘having split apart’
δοιοὺς: δοιοί — two (poetic alternative to δύο); numeral adj., masc. acc. pl.
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκε)
δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without ν-movable
εὐρεῖαν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with σχεδίην ’broad raft’)
εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
ζείδωρον: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. acc. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
θεοῖο: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) · also of a goddess, θεός being common in gender
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐκάλυψεν)
κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; nom. sg.
κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative of κέρδος
κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
κακότητος: κακότης — evil, misery, wretchedness; fem. gen. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’
κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’
κλῦθι: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’hear!’ (regular opening of a prayer)
κρήδεμνον: κρήδεμνον — head-veil (of a woman); also the covering or seal of a wine-jar; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κρατέρ: κρατερός — mighty, strong, harsh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρατέρ’ = κρατερά)
κύρμα: κύρμα — prey, spoil, booty; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become spoil’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
λέκτο: λέγω — count, reckon; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he counted’ · also λέχομαι — lie down to rest; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he lay down’ — the identical forms of two different verbs are a deliberate wordplay
λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
λισσὴ: λισσός — smooth, sheer; adj., fem. nom. sg.
λύτο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented root-aorist form (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed, gave way’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μέσσῃ: μέσος — middle, mid-; epic μέσσος (doubled σ), fem. dat. sg.
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’)
μήκιστα: μακρός — long; superl. adv. μήκιστα: ’at the last, in the end’
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus)
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’
νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe) · also adv. after its verb (anastrophe): ἐτίθει πάρα ’set beside’ (= παρετίθει)
πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.
πέτρῃσι: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
παίδεσσι: παῖς — child, son; dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic παισί)
παύσειε: παύω — stop, cause to cease; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., expressing purpose after a past main verb, + gen.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
ποίησε: ποιέω — make, create, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησε)
ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
πολλὴ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; neut. comp. adv. προτέρω: ’further in’
πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’
πυκιναὶ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; fem. nom. pl.
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv.
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj.
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’)
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg.
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε)
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χεῦ: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., elided (χεῦ’ = χεῦε), idiomatic of heaping up a mound: ’heaped up’ (τύμβον χεῦε ’raised a tomb’)
χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; acc. sg. χρόα
ἀγροῦ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀγροῦ ’out in the country’) · also plain gen. sg. dependent on a noun, ’of the field/farmland’: ἀγροῦ ἐπ’ ἐσχατιήν ’to the edge of the farmland’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀναρπάξασα: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, carry off; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having snatched up’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, plowland, earth; acc. sg.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐείσατο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear; aor. 3 sg. ἐείσατο, unaugmented: ’seemed’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκφυγέειν: ἐκφεύγω — flee from, escape; aor. inf., epic (= Attic ἐκφυγεῖν)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπεσσύμενον: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’rushing on’
ἐπεχεύατο: ἐπιχέω — pour on, heap on, of loose material in bulk; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσχατιῆς: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, remotest part; fem. gen. sg.
ἐυπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. nom. sg. (Calypso’s standing epithet) · also used of Demeter (5.125), so not unique to Calypso despite the parenthetical above
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc./nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (δῶμα ἑὸν ’his own hall’)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔλυσαν: λύω — loose, untie, cast off; aor. 3 pl.
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔχονται: ἔχω (mid.) — hold oneself, cling; pres. mid. 3 pl., + πρός and dat.: ’cling to one another’
ἕλωρ: ἕλωρ — prey, spoil, plunder; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become prey’
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤπειρόνδε: ἤπειρος — mainland; fem. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the mainland’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
ἰχθυόεντα: ἰχθυόεις — fish-filled, teeming with fish; neut. acc. pl. (ἰχθυόεντα κέλευθα ’fish-filled paths’, of the sea) · also masc. acc. sg. w/ πόντον: ’upon the fish-teeming sea’, not only neut. acc. pl. of κέλευθα
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
ἷξε: ἵκω (root aor. ἷξον) — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he reached’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’)
ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο)
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὤλετ: ὄλλυμι — mid. ὄλλυμαι, perish, be lost, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλετ’ = ὤλετο): ’perished’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥόον: ῥόος — current, stream, flow; masc. acc. sg.
